item.title: EFE v1.0.0 General Availability
item.description: EFE v1.0.0 ships today as the first General Availability release. Security baseline : - 0 known HIGH or CRITICAL CVEs at release time (Trivy, Grype scans clean). - SLSA-3 provenance attestations on all artifacts. - Sigstore (cosign + Fulcio + Rekor) keyless signatures on all artifacts. - Distroless container base images. - SBOM (CycloneDX 1.5) embedded in every Docker image. - VEX feed published at https://efe.example.com/security/vex/feed.json. Verify the release : https://github.com/efe-ai/efe/blob/v1.0.0/docs/release/VERIFY_RELEASE.md
